h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Berhampore

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Berhampore

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Berhampore, the headquarters of Murshidabad district in West Bengal, for schools, colleges, municipal parks, government campuses and residential colonies. We manufacture the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and send it to Berhampore by road. Our installation team or a dealer covering eastern India then fixes it on site.

Because the factory is far away, it helps to know the steps in advance. First, you send us the site size, a few photos and the kind of users you expect. We suggest machines and send a layout drawing with each station and its clear space marked. Once you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture the full order and dispatch it in one consignment. Meanwhile, your contractor prepares a raised, drained base, which matters on the Bhagirathi plains where the monsoon is heavy. Then our installers set each machine, grouted or self-standing.

richText.heading: Choosing a starting set for Berhampore

c: A starting set of four machines covers most needs in a town park or school ground. The

covers waist and shoulders. Add a press and a leg station to round out the set. The humid Bengal climate is easy on galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts, as long as the base drains well. We explain cleaning and basic checks at handover.

items.q: What do you need from us to prepare a quote?
items.a: The size of the area, a few photos and the expected users, such as students, walkers or senior citizens. We reply with suggested machines, a layout drawing and a quote.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Murshidabad district?
items.a: Our installation team or a dealer covering eastern India. They fix each machine on a grouted or self-standing base and explain basic upkeep at handover.

items.q: Can we contact you on WhatsApp or phone?
items.a: You can call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.
